lore: Most of the brigade only notices Machine-Readable DevOps Inventory when something is missing, which is exactly the point. Machine-Readable DevOps Inventory scouts inbound supply, checks stock levels against par and secures the route for every ingredient the line depends on; the image the crew uses for it is the loading dock before dawn.
signature_phrase: Par is a promise. I keep it.
